name: Yieldpaper
desc: Financial infrastructure for making capital more productive. Stablecoin liquidity and settlement, asset tokenisation, onchain capital markets, and agentic finance — built for banks, asset managers, treasuries, and payment providers in global and emerging markets.

name: Sovereign Frontier
desc: Started as Bankless Africa. A digital-asset media and research platform — podcast and newsletter on stablecoins, regulation, and market structure, with listeners in more than 100 countries and guests including the CEO of Tether.

name: ideasflip
desc: An agency banking and mobile money network — 10 service locations across Ghanaian cities, in partnership with Fidelity Bank. Banking where the bank branches aren't.

name: Library Protocol
desc: An open-source, onchain book-sharing network. Put a personal, school, or community library onchain, then lend and borrow books across borders — secured by smart contracts and a reputation system instead of a central platform. An open-source public good in the Gitcoin Grants ecosystem.

name: Public Good Africa
desc: A digital-asset-native way to fund public goods across Africa. Helped more than 50 impact projects secure grant funding.
